messages:
Maria - CSM: Quick sync — I assembled the exec pack for StratusHealth EBR. Slides are in the Drive (drive.redwood.com/stratus/exec-pack-v1). Need final usage + renewal-health slide and Priya's sign-off by Thu.
Jordan - Account Exec: Thanks. I'll add ARR and renewal timeline. Noted budget sensitivity from last call — possible concession ask.
Priya - Customer Success Director: Risk = moderate. Onboarding for two regional teams is behind schedule but NPS trending up. We should surface the enablement plan + a recommended exec ask (no pricing promises here).
Kevin - Solutions Eng: I can pull 90/30-day adoption metrics and a 2-min demo clip of the integration flow. Will upload assets to the deck. 
Ashley - Enablement: Recommend a 60-min ops+eng enablement session before the EBR. Can run next Tue 10am PT. I'll also create a short feedback form to capture training questions.
Maria - CSM: Can folks confirm ownership? Draft action list below. React :thumbsup: if this looks right or reply w/ changes.

```
Action items:
- [AI] Jordan - finalize ARR numbers & renewal timeline (due Thu EOD)
- [AI] Kevin - add metrics slide + attach 2-min demo clip (due Wed)
- [AI] Ashley - schedule enablement session + share invite (due Wed)
- [AI] Maria - consolidate slides and produce 1-page exec summary (due Thu)
- [AI] Priya - draft exec alignment note on risk & fallback options (due Thu)
```

Jordan - Account Exec: Got it. I'll update the deck and drop ARR slide in slide 4. @Maria can you paste the one-pager template?
Maria - CSM: Using the exec-ask template in Drive -> templates/exec_onepager.md. Quick snippet for the ask section: "Clear ask: 3-month pilot extension + targeted enablement; proposed approval path: CFO -> Head of Ops." Keep wording factual.
Priya - Customer Success Director: Agree — factual framing only. No pricing commitments without legal sign-off.
Ashley - Enablement: I'll make the Google Form for feedback and add 3 forced-choice questions + open text. Will link results to slide 8.
packbot: Reminder: EBR exec pack deadline in 48 hours. :alarm_clock:
Maria - CSM: Final review slot Thurs 4pm PT? I'll send calendar invite once everyone confirms.
Jordan - Account Exec: :thumbsup: booked on my side.
Kevin - Solutions Eng: Uploading demo clip now, will post link in the thread when done.
Maria - CSM: Great work team — circling back Thurs after final edits. Thanks!
